resources.string:
"chiara-select2speak" is a service to read aloud text on the screen, to ease access for users with reading difficulties.

 The service overlays on top of visible content, and allows users to select a screen area and read aloud the text inside it.
 This service is inspired by the "Android Select to Speak" and builds additional functionalities on top of it. The latter can not read text not directly exposed to the Android operating system (e.g. text inside apps, images, and videogames).
 "chiara-select2speak" is specifically developed to enable recognizing (and reading-aloud) also such text.
To use this app, you must enable the "chiara-select2speak" service under Accessibility settings > Applicazioni installate > "chiara-select2speak".
